title: His Preservation Hall band and quarrels over how it plays
summary: He names the musicians in his band at Preservation Hall and complains about the people who control who gets hired.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players
